name: Overhaul
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on *only* PRs from new contributors for two weeks, then expand to all PRs for one week *only if* reviewer engagement metrics (e.g., comment resolution rate) improve by 20% or more. This reduces initial noise while still validating scalability under controlled conditions.

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on *all* PRs for one week first. This gives us a full baseline of its impact across the codebase, not just on new contributors. The trade-off is temporary noise in reviews and possible slowdowns, but it’s the only way to measure real-world performance before narrowing scope. Without this baseline, we risk optimizing for the wrong subset of data or missing edge cases that only appear in veteran PRs.

name: Ratchet
text:
DECISION: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on *only* new-contributor PRs for two weeks, then expand to all PRs for one week *only if* reviewer engagement metrics (e.g., comment resolution rate) improve by 20% or more.

Result: A controlled baseline of PR-Agent’s impact without polluting veteran reviews, followed by a scalable validation if metrics justify it. Owner: Sprocket.
